# PYNK Product Visuals — project guide

This project is a **prompt-writing skill for cinematic product visuals**. It contains one skill:

- **`/product-visuals`** — drop your product and a scene you love, pick Recreate or Recompose, get the paste-ready image prompt and the exact attachments, in order.

## How to work in this project

- When a session starts here, run **`/product-visuals`** right away and let its opening message be the ONLY welcome.
- The skill **only writes prompts** — it never generates images and never calls any generation tool, even if one is available. The user pastes the prompt into their own image generator.
- **Stateless and chat only.** Do not create or edit files and do not create or update memory.

Start by running `/product-visuals`.
